copy.headline: ACCESS ON PAPER IS NOT DELIVERED SUPPLY
copy.deck: ASEAN proposes cross-border emergency fuel rights while a Polish LNG buyer terminates one Qatari contract and a US-bound Russian diesel cargo faces commercial refusal. Reports on Irish alumina and a Chinese gas discovery expose further gaps between inputs, permissions and outcomes.
copy.mechanism: Legal and financial entitlements are separate from physical stock, buyer acceptance, and commissioned production.
copy.chainNote: EMERGENCY PURCHASE OPTION → STORED FUEL → RELEASE AND DELIVERY
copy.evidenceNote: The ASEAN plan is based on Reuters citing Nikkei; envisaged 14 November letters of intent and a 2027 start are not completed facts on 12 November.
copy.footer: RIGHT ≠ INVENTORY · WAIVER ≠ BUYER · TEST ≠ SUPPLY
